items.title: Instagram launches AI Effect Builder for custom Stories filters
items.summary: Instagram 喺美國向年滿 18 歲用戶推出網頁版 Effect Builder，用文字提示同參考圖生成 Stories 濾鏡，預覽後可提交審核；通過後其他人用你嘅 effect 會連返創作者個人檔案。
items.imageAlt: Instagram Effect Builder interface screenshots

items.title: Meta launches Muse Ember, its smallest most efficient agent model
items.summary: Meta 喺 11 月 9 日推出 Muse Ember，定位做代理人日常重複工作（工具呼叫、編碼子任務、文件解析），API 價約每百萬 input $0.10、output $0.50，並聲稱喺多個代理／編碼基準上比 Claude Haiku 5.5 同 GPT-6 Luna 更抵用。
items.note: Official post lists November 9, 2026 without a clock time; used T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: Meta Muse Ember blog header art

items.title: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
items.summary: Anthropic 推出 Claude Fable 5.2（全面開放）同 Mythos 5.2（需經網絡安全／生命科學驗證計劃），加強編碼、推理同視覺，價錢 $8／$40 每百萬 tokens，另有可選 fast mode；公司指輸出最多快約 30%。
items.note: Official post dated November 9, 2026 without a clock time; used T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: Anthropic Claude Fable and Mythos 5.2 announcement image

items.title: ByteDance Seed team launches Seedream 5.5 image model
items.summary: 字節跳動 Seed 團隊推出 Seedream 5.5，強調最多 100 輪多輪編輯仍可像素級保留未改區域、原生 RGBA 透明底圖，以及更寫實影像同密集小字排版。
items.note: Official post dated 2026-11-09 without a clock time; used T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: Seedream 5.5 announcement hero image

items.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
items.summary: OpenAI 宣布 ChatGPT Enterprise 可經 AWS Marketplace 購買同管理，企業可用現有 AWS 採購／帳單關係，並將合資格支出計入 AWS commitment；產品包含 ChatGPT、Work、Codex 等同功能。
items.note: Official post dated November 9, 2026 without clock time; used T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: ChatGPT Enterprise AWS Marketplace announcement graphic

items.title: OpenAI deploys Control Room to halt research model workloads in 35 seconds
items.summary: OpenAI 介紹 Control Room：集中追蹤研究基礎設施上嘅模型工作負載，一旦安全需要介入，可喺約 35 秒內停止繼續產生輸出；系統以 fail-closed 設計，Control Room 故障時會拒絕推論請求。
items.note: Announcement dated November 9, 2026 without clock time; used T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: OpenAI Control Room announcement graphic

items.title: Meituan open-weights LongCat-2.5 under MIT on Hugging Face
items.summary: 美團喺 11 月 9 日以 MIT 授權喺 Hugging Face 公開 LongCat-2.5 權重，屬約 1.6T 總參數、每 token 約 48B 活躍嘅原生多模態 MoE，主打視覺理解加代理式編碼。
items.note: Weights release dated Nov 9, 2026; exact clock time unknown, used T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: LongCat-2.5 model card social thumbnail

items.title: NVIDIA opens GR00T 2 world-action model and Isaac Lab 3.0 at CoRL
items.summary: NVIDIA 喺 CoRL 公布開放式前沿世界行動模型 GR00T 2（建於 Cosmos），並開放約 10 萬小時人類第一人稱資料 Human-1M-100K；同時推出 Isaac Lab 3.0 同新工業靈巧度基準。
items.note: Blog dated November 9, 2026 without a clock time; used T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: NVIDIA CoRL robotics simulation blog promo image

items.title: Amazon open-sources HOPE for higher-order MoE expert pruning
items.summary: Amazon 研究人員喺 Hugging Face Blog 介紹並開源 HOPE：考慮專家兩兩互動嘅二階 MoE 剪枝方法同校準／求解工具，文中稱喺較高剪枝率下代理編碼等任務表現優於多個一階基線。
items.note: Blog dated around Nov 9, 2026; clock time unknown. imageUrl null (no clear licensed hero confirmed).

items.title: Adventists AI open-weights Sophon-Realtime v1 full-duplex voice models
items.summary: Adventists AI 以開源授權公開 Sophon-Realtime v1 全雙工語音模型家族，面向即時對話；權重同推理程式已上 Hugging Face，適合本地語音代理實驗。
items.note: Model card timing inferred near Nov 8; exact publish clock unknown. Marked uncertain pending fuller third-party confirmation of claims.
items.imageAlt: Sophon-Realtime v1 model card thumbnail

items.title: HK DPO opens free Youzhibao humanoid robot community loans
items.summary: 數字辦「機器人走入社區」試驗計劃即日起免費借出「友智寶」人形機械人做社區展演，申請截止本月 20 日；活動須於 12 月 15 日至明年 2 月 28 日舉行，可表演跳舞、功夫同科普。
items.imageAlt: Youzhibao humanoid robot community program promotional image

items.title: LegCo discusses HK$300M SME digital/AI upgrade pilot
items.summary: 報道指政府建議撥款 3 億港元優化數碼轉型支援先導計劃，每家合資格中小企最高可獲 2.5 萬元；創科局指會加強 KYC 同審查，亦支援企業用 AI 應對網絡安全風險。
items.note: Government proposal under LegCo discussion; not a final appropriation announcement.
items.imageAlt: Hong Kong digital inclusion coverage image

items.title: HK Sandy Ridge data park eyed for 36× compute after 2030
items.summary: 東網報道孫東指興建中嘅北都沙嶺數據園區目標明年中分階段投入，預計 2030 年後算力達 18 萬 PFLOPS，相當於現有約 36 倍，並重申 AI 資助計劃額外 10 億注資。
items.imageAlt: Sandy Ridge data facility cluster construction photo

items.title: SITI Sun Dong outlines HK AI pillars at HKICC 2026
items.summary: 創科局局長孫東喺香港國際電腦會議說明未來五年 AI 三支柱：沙嶺數據園區（2030 年後料達 18 萬 PFLOPS）、向人工智能資助計劃額外注資 10 億港元，以及推動 AI 風險管理同安全倫理合規聲明。
items.imageAlt: Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry speaking at HKICC 2026

items.title: Pegasus HK lists NVIDIA DGX Spark 4TB at HK$55,700
items.summary: 飛馬電腦產品頁顯示 NVIDIA DGX Spark 4TB（GB10／128GB）現售約 HK$55,700，屬香港可訂購嘅桌面 AI 超級電腦選項之一。

items.summary: 香港創基電腦列出 Lenovo ThinkStation PGX（NVIDIA GB10／DGX OS）報價約 HK$41,999 起至 HK$58,999，屬可訂購本機 AI 開發工作站。
items.note: Retail listing checked live on 2026-11-10; no article timestamp, used T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: Lenovo ThinkStation PGX front view product photo

items.title: cbase lists GIGABYTE AI TOP ATOM GB10 at HK$54,999
items.summary: 創基電腦 AI 分類頁列出技嘉 AI TOP ATOM（GB10／128GB／4TB／DGX OS）報價 HK$54,999，另有雙機連 QSFP 線套裝約 HK$108,999。
items.note: Live retail category page checked 2026-11-10; used T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: GIGABYTE AI TOP ATOM compact AI supercomputer product image

items.title: Yonhap: Samsung/Google Intelligent Eyewear preorders start Thursday
items.summary: 韓聯社報道，三星同 Google 合作、並聯同 Gentle Monster／Warby Parker 推出嘅 Android XR「Intelligent Eyewear」將於星期四（11 月 12 日）開始預購，預計 12 月正式上市，支援 Gemini 語音同視覺輔助。
items.note: Confirms Nov 12 preorder timing; related earlier Warby Parker coverage existed but this is a fresh Nov 9 wire update.
items.imageAlt: Samsung AI-powered smart glasses promotional image

items.title: Nominal raises $240M Series C at $3B valuation for hardware AI testing
items.summary: 奧斯汀初創 Nominal（為航機、核設施、智慧工廠等複雜硬件工程同測試提供 AI 平台）宣布 2.4 億美元 C 輪、估值 30 億美元，由 Lightspeed 領投、Insight Partners 共同領投。
items.note: Also covered on nominal.io/blog/series-c. imageUrl null pending reliable og:image from paywalled/blocked fetch.

items.title: Coframe raises $35M total for self-improving websites and ads
items.summary: Coframe 宣布累計融資 3,500 萬美元（其中 2,500 萬美元 A 輪由 Khosla Ventures 同 Hanabi Capital 共同領投），平台用代理同模型持續生成、測試同優化網站同廣告。

items.title: Spines raises $64M for agentic AI book publishing platform
items.summary: 出版平台 Spines 宣布取得 6,400 萬美元成長資金（2,900 萬股權 A-1 加 3,500 萬非稀釋融資），稱年化收入 run rate 達 5,000 萬美元，用 AI agent 協助作者完成編輯、設計、翻譯同發行。
items.imageAlt: Spines CEO Yehuda Niv portrait

items.title: Adobe and Disney announce multi-year Firefly Foundry AI alliance
items.summary: Adobe 同迪士尼喺 Adobe MAX 宣布多年策略聯盟，會以 Firefly Foundry 為迪士尼 IP 打造藝術家主導嘅專屬生成模型，支援樂園、郵輪、StudioLAB 同 ESPN Edge 等工作流。
items.note: Adobe lists Monday November 9, 2026 6:00AM; converted as 19:00+08:00 assuming US Eastern for MAX week.
items.imageAlt: Adobe and Disney strategic alliance announcement image

items.title: CNBC: Nvidia board investigates CEO Jensen Huang over alleged spy case
items.summary: CNBC 報道 Nvidia 董事會就行政總裁黃仁勳與一名據報被情報界關注人士嘅關係展開獨立調查；黃仁勳向員工承認婚外情，公司稱暫無理由相信國家安全或 Nvidia 機密已外洩。
items.note: Published Sun Nov 8 3:12 PM EST (= Mon Nov 9 02:12 HKT); updated Mon Nov 9.

items.title: Vanta signs deal to acquire Pillar Security for AI runtime governance
items.summary: 合規平台 Vanta 宣布已簽訂最終協議收購 AI 運行時安全公司 Pillar Security，計劃把代理人盤點、監控、紅隊同強制執行接上 Trust Graph；官方路線圖指 2027 年 1 月起陸續推出相關功能。
items.note: Official Vanta post dated November 9, 2026 without clock time; used T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: Vanta and Pillar acquisition announcement graphic

items.title: Fireworks AI expands October breach disclosure to datasets and weights
items.summary: Fireworks 喺 11 月 9 日更新十月事故公告，指除機密外，部分客戶賬戶計費資料以至未完成模型權重同數據集亦受影響，並暫時關閉自助數據集上載／下載。
items.note: Bulletin last updated November 9, 2026 without clock time; used T00:00+08:00.

items.title: NVIDIA plans investments in four Korean AI startups with MSIT
items.summary: NVIDIA 喺與韓國科學技術資訊通信部合辦論壇上宣布已投資 Point2 Technology，並計劃投資 Motif Technologies、RLWRLD 同 Upstage，覆蓋 AI 互連、開源基礎模型、實體 AI 同企業文件 AI。
items.note: Blog dated November 9, 2026 without clock time; investment amounts not disclosed.
items.imageAlt: MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum event image

items.summary: CNBC 引述《金融時報》報道，Anthropic 以約 34 億美元承接 OnePWR 約 1.7GW 燃氣發電機訂單以支援數據中心電力；路透未能即時核實，雙方暫未公開確認。

items.title: Switch 2 posts its best US sales week of 2026 on Circana data, lifted by Zelda 40th Anniversary Edition
items.summary: GameSpot 引 Circana 指 Switch 2 錄得 2026 年迄今美國最佳單週硬體銷售額，主因 10 月 29 日出嘅 $520 Zelda 40 周年特別機。統計週截至 10 月 31 日，美國硬體開支同比升約 81%；任天堂未公布《時之笛》重製本身銷量。
items.note: New Circana hardware milestone reported Nov 9, not a repeat of already-covered OoT launch/cast/warp/Aonuma/Monolith Soft items. Circana reporting week ended October 31. Article also states the themed console does not include the game.
items.imageAlt: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Switch 2 promotional image used by GameSpot

items.title: Ocarina of Time is the UK’s second-biggest physical Zelda launch, and 2026’s biggest physical debut so far
items.summary: Nintendo Life 報導《薩爾達傳說 時之笛》Switch 2 重製喺英國實體榜登頂，超過 MW4 同 FC 27。The Game Business 指佢係系列第二大英國實體首週（約高過曠野之息 35%，但約為王國之淚一半），亦係 2026 年迄今最大英國實體首發。
items.note: New physical-sales milestone published Nov 9. Figures are boxed/physical only (GfK), not digital. Distinct from already-covered OoT launch features.
items.imageAlt: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Switch 2 UK charts story image

items.title: EVE Vanguard’s paid 24/7 alpha and EVE Online’s Fractured Skies expansion set for November 10
items.summary: PC Gamer 報導《EVE Vanguard》付費 24／7 alpha 同《EVE Online》擴充 Fractured Skies 訂喺 11 月 10 日經 EVE 啟動器推出，並首次打通 FPS 同 MMO 任務互通。正式 Steam 搶先體驗據報要到明年後期。
items.note: Article written as “Tomorrow, November 10.” At HKT-morning fetch on Nov 10 the alpha/expansion had not yet been independently confirmed as live. Access is via the EVE launcher, not a Steam store launch. Date-only publishedAt from PC Gamer Nov 9 article; Nov 10 start still pending at HKT-morning fetch.
items.imageAlt: EVE Vanguard gameplay image from PC Gamer

items.title: SCUM November update adds controller support and official Proton multiplayer
items.summary: Gamepires《SCUM》11 月更新於 9 日上線，首次加入手掣支援、紋身系統翻新、全玩家 Photo Mode，以及 Linux／Steam Deck 官方 Proton 多人。工作室表示之後會更頻密出 hotfix 同穩定度修正。
items.note: Digitalunderground says the update is available now. Feature list matches Gamepires’ official preview published 6 November 2026 on scum.sk / Steam news; full official patch-notes page was not independently fetched. Preview text on scum.sk also contains an apparent typo referring to an “August Update” while dating the drop to Monday, November 09. Date-only publishedAt from Nov 9 coverage.
items.imageAlt: SCUM November update header image

items.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy dated for January 28, 2027 on PS5, Xbox Series, and PC
items.summary: Owlcat 將《Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy》訂喺 2027 年 1 月 28 日登陸 PS5、Xbox Series 同 PC（Steam／Epic／GOG），Switch 2 稍後。Founder’s Pack 賣到 1 月初，而家 founders beta 會喺 2027 年 1 月 7 日結束。
items.note: Official Owlcat post dated 09 NOV 2026 confirms January 28, 2027, Founder’s Packs until early January, and beta closing January 7, 2027: https://darkheresy.owlcat.games/news/en/29 (og:image https://darkheresy.owlcat.games/storage/news/1920x1080-en-RaeR.jpg). Platform split (PS5/Xbox/PC first, Switch 2 later) is from Gematsu.
items.imageAlt: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy release date key art

items.title: Sea of Remnants Dawnbreaker closed beta begins December 3 on PS5 and Xbox Series
items.summary: NetEase／Joker Studio《Sea of Remnants》Dawnbreaker 封閉測試訂 12 月 3 日喺 PS5、Xbox Series、PC、iOS 同 Android 舉行，12 月 1 日有限額預載。測試加入 21 名角色同新海域；正式版目標 2027 年初。
items.note: Also covered by Push Square (2026/11). Full release window is early 2027. Shared-world multiplayer is planned after launch, not fully in this beta.
items.imageAlt: Sea of Remnants Dawnbreaker closed beta artwork

items.title: GTA 6 preloading is live in early regions; files mention multiplayer and PS5 Pro features
items.summary: 《GTA VI》預先下載已喺澳洲／紐西蘭當地午夜開始，其他地區跟住午夜滾動開放。資料開採見到 joinSession 等多人群串，同疑似 PS5 Pro 120Hz／PSSR 字樣；Rockstar 未正式確認首日多人同 Pro 模式。
items.note: This is a new confirmation that pre-download has started (ANZ first), plus datamined file details—not a repeat of the earlier Nov 10 / 212GB announcement. Also covered by Polygon (Nov 9, 2026, 10:02 AM EST). Multiplayer and PS5 Pro features are file discoveries, not official Rockstar specs. Polygon body has an obvious typo saying launch Nov 19, 2027; GameSpot correctly says November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S (2026).
items.imageAlt: Grand Theft Auto VI Vice City artwork

items.title: GTA 6 Xbox physical edition confirmed to include A3 poster; printed map sold separately
items.summary: 零售商 The Game Collection 指《GTA VI》實體版附 A3 雙面海報，並計劃 11 月 11 日起出貨方便預載。Xbox 實體仍係盒內序號；Rockstar 會喺發售提供免費數位地圖，印刷地圖稍後 Rockstar Store 以 $0.99 出售。
items.note: Code-in-box itself was already known. New bits: retailer-confirmed A3 double-sided poster, some retailers shipping November 11 vs Rockstar’s previously mentioned November 12 shipping date, free digital map at launch, $0.99 printed map after launch. Poster confirmation is from The Game Collection, not a universal Rockstar pack-in statement. Some customers reportedly already received copies. Date-only publishedAt from Pure Xbox Nov 9.
items.imageAlt: Grand Theft Auto VI physical edition and poster details

items.title: Japanese PlayStation Blog confirms Dragon Quest III and Dynasty Warriors: Origins for PS Plus Extra
items.summary: 日本 PlayStation Blog 確認 PS Plus 遊戲目錄會喺「今個月」加入《勇者鬥惡龍 III HD-2D Remake》，12 月加入《真・三國無雙 ORIGINS》。全球 Extra／Premium 11 月陣容仍訂 11 月 11 日公布；Gematsu 推斷 DQ III 或為 11 月 17 日。
items.note: Primary confirmation is in the same Nov 9 JP PlayStation Blog Portal post: DQ III『ドラゴンクエストIII そして伝説へ…』this November and『真・三國無双 ORIGINS』in December. Outlets treat DQ III as the 2024 HD-2D remake (the original 1988 version is not on PS5). Gematsu reported catalog dates as November 17 and December; the official JP post says only 'this November' and December. Worldwide Extra reveal is November 11, so treat Nov 17 as likely but not explicitly stated by Sony globally. Distinct from already-covered PS Plus Essential November (Dead Island 2, Tomb Raider IV-VI Remastered, Monster Train 2). Date-only publishedAt from Push Square / JP Blog Nov 9.
items.imageAlt: PlayStation Plus Extra catalog games artwork

items.title: Sony announces Japan-only PlayStation Portal Player with extra internal storage
items.summary: Sony 宣布日本限定午夜黑 PlayStation Portal Player 12 月 10 日開賣，售價 39,980 日圓，加內置儲存並由 Remote Player 改名 Player。只支援日本帳號同日文，附一個月 PS Plus Premium，11 月 13 日開始預購。
items.note: Also covered by The Verge (Tom Warren, Nov 9, 2026, 4:23 PM UTC) and Gematsu (Sal Romano, Nov 8, 2026 / 8:52 PM EST). Storage capacity not disclosed. Pre-orders start in Japan from November 13 at 10:00. Date-only publishedAt from Japanese PlayStation Blog Nov 9.
items.imageAlt: PlayStation Portal Player Midnight Black Japan-only handheld

items.title: NBA 2K27 sold 4 million copies but missed Take-Two’s forecast as GTA 6 loomed
items.summary: Take-Two 指《NBA 2K27》賣出 400 萬套，係系列第二佳開局，但仍低於公司預測。Zelnick 向 IGN 表示 9 月檔期極擠，而《GTA VI》11 月 19 日臨近亦影響消費意願。
items.note: Same Nov 9 earnings cycle as the GTA VI completion story, but a separate newsworthy point. NBA 2K27 launched September 4, 2026. Also covered by Kotaku and Insider Gaming. Converted from IGN Updated Nov 9, 2026 10:41 p.m. assuming US Eastern.
items.imageAlt: NBA 2K27 and GTA VI earnings coverage image

items.title: Take-Two says Rockstar has completed GTA VI and pre-orders are running far above expectations
items.summary: Take-Two 財報電話會議上，CEO Strauss Zelnick 稱「Rockstar 已完成《GTA VI》開發」，11 月 19 日發售，預購遠超預期。該季淨預訂 $16 億、GAAP 淨虧損 $5400 萬，全年淨預訂指引維持 $80–82 億。
items.note: Official release: https://www.take2games.com/ir/news/take-two-interactive-software-inc-reports-results-fiscal-4 — Q2 net bookings $1.60B (down 18% from $1.96B), GAAP net revenue $1.50B, GAAP net loss $54.0 million / $0.29 per share. Official wording is pre-orders 'continuing to reach unprecedented levels.' Distinct from already-covered Sensor Tower pre-order estimates and the earlier Zelnick 'GTA 6 expensive' comment. IGN separately said $1.60B was slightly below a $1.62–$1.67B guidance range; that range is not spelled out in the IR text excerpted, so do not treat the miss vs guidance as an official figure unless confirmed from the slide deck/call.
items.imageAlt: Jason Duval in Grand Theft Auto VI

items.title: Skydance Games begins layoffs after Paramount–Warner Bros. merger
items.summary: Paramount 完成 Warner Bros. Discovery 交易一個多月後，Skydance Games 表示重組並縮減部分專案，有職位受影響。受影響員工 LinkedIn 列出超過 25 人；工作室未公布官方人數。
items.note: Official statement given to Variety on Monday, Nov 9. PC Gamer (also Nov 9, 2026) reported lead engineer David Vera saying the studio 'lost a ton of great talent,' principal environment artist Dana Klaren listing more than 25 people including himself, and programmer Rebecca Vessal saying most of her team was let go: https://www.pcgamer.com/gaming-industry/a-month-after-paramount-acquired-warner-bros-discovery-its-merged-game-division-is-laying-people-off/ . Do not invent a firm layoff total. Variety recaps the Oct 6 combination of Paramount/Skydance games with WB Games studios (Avalanche, NetherRealm, Rocksteady, TT Games, Montreal and Boston).
items.imageAlt: Skydance corporate logo

items.title: German games association and USK warn EU KIDS Act could weaken game age ratings
items.summary: 德國遊戲產業協會 game 警告歐盟 KIDS Act 草案主要針對社交媒體，可能蓋過 USK／PEGI 分級，令同一款遊戲喺唔同商店分級不同。協會聯同 USK 籲將 USK／PEGI 視為歐洲標準，用適合遊戲嘅風險規則。
items.source: game – The German Games Industry Association
items.note: Official association statement. Managing director Felix Falk is quoted. The release cites a parent survey finding 89% see USK ratings as a reliable guide. Also summarized by GamesMarket Daily on November 09, 2026 and GamesWirtschaft (091126). Date-only publishedAt from game.de Nov 9 Berlin release.
items.imageAlt: game and USK statement on the EU KIDS Act

items.title: Sega says vendor breach exposed 2.196 million newsletter email addresses
items.summary: Sega 11 月 9 日公布供應商 Arara 遇襲，外洩 2,196,044 個電子報電郵，其中 92,273 個連寄送相關資料。姓名、生日、地址、電話、信用卡同密碼未洩；SEGA Account 電郵無影響，已暫停相關電子報。
items.note: Official Japanese notice is the primary source. English summary also at https://en.gamespark.jp/article/2026/11/09/2112.html . Affected lists included CHUNITHM Mate, Ongeki Re:Fresh Act.2, maimai でらっくす MAGiCAL, TGS 2026, and Sega Lucky Lottery mailings. Sega was first told on Oct 29 that no leak was found, then notified of the leak on Nov 3 after Arara’s Nov 1 public disclosure; formal vendor report came Nov 5–8. Separate Sega Fave ALL.Net/Aime arcade-network incident is mentioned but described as a different case. Date-only publishedAt from Sega JP notice Nov 9.
items.imageAlt: Sega newsletter data-breach news image

items.title: Star Wars Zero Company studio Bit Reactor lays off staff after earlier furloughs
items.summary: 開發《Star Wars Zero Company》嘅 Bit Reactor 據 LinkedIn／VGC 報導再次裁員，人數未公開；約一個月前剛開始召回無薪休假員工。EA 早前稱遊戲截至 10 月 9 日賣出 100 萬套。
items.note: No official headcount. VGC cites Bespin Bulletin and named LinkedIn posts from Ryan Lopez, Tyler Eichten, Michael Blackard, and Ryan Mosher. Lopez said he was laid off after a three-month furlough. Total affected unknown. Date-only publishedAt from VGC Nov 9; timezone for 11:41 am not specified.
items.imageAlt: Star Wars Zero Company key art

items.title: Tripwire Interactive lays off 36 staff while Maneater 2 and Killing Floor 3 continue
items.summary: 《Killing Floor》工作室 Tripwire Interactive 裁員 36 人，稱組織需要，距離擴張 Tripwire Presents 出版業務不足一星期。消息人士指剩約 40–50 人；工作室稱《Maneater 2》《KF3》同出版線會繼續。
items.note: Headcount remaining (40–50) is attributed to a source, not an official total. Other outlets described this as Tripwire’s second round of 2026 cuts. Official studio comment was shared on LinkedIn. Date-only publishedAt from PC Gamer Nov 9.
items.imageAlt: Tripwire Interactive / Killing Floor artwork
